locations.title: Sand Worm
locations.description:
**Mission Required:** [El Camino: Expedition](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=150413)

**Tip:** Use a powerful ranged weapon and aim for the mouth.  The worm's ranged attacks are easy to dodge but its melee attack deals massive damage and can one hit kill.  Bring poison antidote.  Note that running away from the battle can cause the worm to despawn preventing you from continuing the mission.

locations.title: Wolf
locations.description:
**Mission Required:** [Kill List: Extermination](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154651), [Kill List: Hard Extermination](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154949), or [Kill List: Hardcore Extermination](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154950)

**Tip:** Only spawns at night during the mission.  Damaging him enough will cause him to retreat into his den where he'll regain back a portion of health.  When he comes back out, several wolves will spawn.  This mechanic needs to repeat several times before you're able to kill him.

locations.title: Panther
locations.description:
**Mission Required:** [Wet Work: Extermination](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154668) or [Wet Work: Hardcore Extermination](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154954)

**Tip:** Prepare as needed before the fight.  Build a platform to gain height on the animal, or stand on a nearby rock.  He should not be able to attack you if you're high enough and you can rain arrows down from above.

locations.title: Sand Worm
locations.description:
**Mission Required:** [Dust Up: Extermination](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154808) or [Dust Up: Hardcore Extermination](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154955)  

**Tip:** Use a powerful ranged weapon and aim for the mouth.  The worm's ranged attacks are easy to dodge but its melee attack deals massive damage and can one hit kill.  Bring poison antidote.  Note that running away from the battle can cause the worm to despawn preventing you from continuing the mission.

locations.title: Mammoth
locations.description:
**Mission Required:** [Clean Up: Extermination](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154943) or [Clean Up: Hardcore Extermination](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154956)

**Tip:** The Mammoth walks relatively slow. Its head area is a little bit above its eye level. Beware for wolf groups that spawn in the arctic, which pose even more threat than the Mammoth.

locations.title: Polar Bear
locations.description:
**Mission Required:** [Voyager: Recovery (Hardcore)](https://mapgenie.io/icarus/maps/icarus?locationIds=154928)

**Tip:** There isn't much cover here so building a small raised platform to stand on is recommended.  A tier 2+ knife is required for skinning the bear.

locations.title: Alpha Wolf
locations.description:
Mission Required: BIG SHOT: Hardcore Stockpile

Tip: Only spawns at night during the mission. Damaging him enough will cause him to retreat into his den where he'll regain back a portion of health. When he comes back out, several wolves will spawn. This mechanic needs to repeat several times before you're able to kill him.
